custom_field_member_scope_check.name: custom_field_member_scope_check
custom_field_member_scope_check.value: ("custom_field"."field_type" = 'member') = ("custom_field"."member_scope" IS NOT NULL) AND ("custom_field"."member_scope" IS NULL OR "custom_field"."member_scope" IN ('all', 'humans', 'agents'))

issue_activity_owner_check.name: issue_activity_owner_check
issue_activity_owner_check.value: ("issue_activity"."issue_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("issue_activity"."initiative_id" IS NOT NULL)

team_invite_project_role_check.name: team_invite_project_role_check
team_invite_project_role_check.value:
("team_invite"."project_id" IS NULL AND "team_invite"."project_role" IS NULL)
        OR ("team_invite"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "team_invite"."project_role" IN ('owner', 'member'))
